body:
> Found while documenting #121, verified on this board and on pipao-v2 on 2026-08-28.
> **Re-scoped after #115's verify pass shipped PR #135 (`f25bbb8`)**, which fixed the core of this
> from inside a live worker.

# Goal: hkb's hooks and session recording actually run for the default profile

This is the root of a track: the verify-and-synthesize pass after #132, #133 and #134. Read them;
do not redo them.

## Where things stand

- **Landed in #135:** the Stop hook derives the attempt from the `kb-<n>-<k>` worktree; the terminal
  verb records `session_id`/`transcript_path`; `hkb stats` prices a `claude-bg` attempt from its
  transcript (`~$6.64 estimated` was the first real number). README/docs updated.
- **#132** — verb-less attempts (crash/timeout/violation) get their session from the dispatcher.
- **#133** — a human decides whether hkb's PreToolUse policy becomes live on `claude-bg`; if (b), it
  resolves the profile once per attempt.
- **#134** — `hkb doctor` says when a profile's recording or enforcement is inert.

## What to do

1. Confirm on a fresh `claude-bg` attempt: session fields on the row, a nudge trail, a price.
2. Kill one deliberately (or observe a timeout) and confirm #132 stamped it anyway.
3. **Settle the #112 question with one live test**: from a real worker, run a terminal verb whose
   `--from-stdin` heredoc contains `|`, `;`, `&&`. If Claude Code's native allowlist denies it, that
   is what the pilot hit and #124 did not fix it — file it with the exact denial text. If it passes,
   say so. Nothing on the board has answered this yet.
4. `hkb doctor` ok here; warns on a fixture board.
5. `npm run lint && npm test`; smoke if package-read contents changed.

Any seam between the four PRs: fixed here or filed. Complete with numbers, not a summary of the plan.
goal: the Stop hook fires for claude-bg workers, or doctor says it cannot
title: A claude --bg worker never sees KB_TASK, so its Stop hook records nothing and never nudges
